g.text: 01 RIVER STONE / concealed iPhone mounting layout
Original 01 only • proposed envelopes and service paths • dimensions in mm • not fit CAD
1 FRONT / viewed normal to screen
Dashed: hidden 150.9 × 75.7 phone body
Notch left / Lightning right; 6 mm overlap; R3 trial corners
2 SECTION / proposed 50° tilt
UGREEN bank
Rear allowance to bank bay: 15.1 mm vertical plane gap
Dashed body is illustrative; actual curved-shell fit unverified
3 UNDERSIDE / cover removed — plan projection
Cable
Bank bay 151 × 76
Phone projection above
Side service space reserved; bank port orientation must be checked
4 MICROPHONES / protected zones
A Front / notch: open space under left mask; no gasket over inlet.
B Rear-camera zone: keep cradle and padding clear; vent to side.
C Lightning end: keep mic openings clear of plug, cable and pads.
Each zone needs an independent short, broad route to room air.
No small sealed cavity or shared sealed gasket around the phone.
Exact inlet locations and passage sections await physical mapping.
Assembly / service
Open underside → fit padded cradle and phone → connect lead.
Fit bank independently with removable restraint; close cover.
Keep access for buttons, unplugging and recovery underneath.
Body planning envelope: 240 W × 170 D × 105 H — provisional.
No glass pressure; no camera contact; no acoustic pass claimed.
